quotes.text: Work hard in silence. Let success be your noise.

For any young boy or girl wanting to achieve their dreams, anything is possible with hard work when nobody else is watching, to go through the ups and downs, to learn from resilience, determination and self-belief.

My journey wasn’t straight forward. I wasn’t the kid who went straight to the top - I had to experience the downs, I had to experience a lot of low moods, I had to fight my way to be the very best right now and I hope that can give you inspiration.
I had to bide my time and work hard, a lot of times it was me against my own mind and I had to come through it, I had to show self-belief, determination.
Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing or learning to do.
We have to change from doubters to believers. Now.
I’ve said before that football always seems the most important of the least important things.
Playing football is very simple, but playing simple football is the hardest thing there is.
You play football with your head, and your legs are there to help you.
Why couldn’t you beat a richer club? I’ve never seen a bag of money score a goal.

Technique is not being able to juggle a ball 1000 times. Anyone can do that by practising. Then you can work in the circus. Technique is passing the ball with one touch, with the right speed, at the right foot of your team mate.
Football is a game of mistakes. Whoever makes the fewest mistakes wins.
You have to fight to reach your dream. You have to sacrifice and work hard for it.

The great fallacy is that the game is first and last about winning. It is nothing of the kind. The game is about glory, it is about doing things in style and with a flourish, about going out and beating the other lot, not waiting for them to die of boredom.
It is better to fail aiming high than to succeed aiming low.
quotes.who: Bill Nicholson (as published by Tottenham; some historians credit Danny Blanchflower)

quotes.text: If you are first you are first. If you are second you are nothing.
For a player to be good enough to play for Liverpool, he must be prepared to run through a brick wall for me then come out fighting on the other side.
Without fans who pay at the turnstile, football is nothing. Sometimes we are inclined to forget that.

What is a club in any case? Not the buildings or the directors or the people who are paid to represent it. It’s not the television contracts, get-out clauses, marketing departments or executive boxes. It’s the noise, the passion, the feeling of belonging, the pride in your city.
The legacy of this tournament is a change in society. We’ve brought everyone together, brought people to games.
Stick to the plan, stick together and keep the noise out.
I’m telling you right now … England is still a place where a naughty boy who comes from nothing can live his dream.
We didn’t win by luck – from start to finish it was an incredible performance.
quotes.who: Roberto Martínez (after Wigan's 2013 FA Cup final win)

quotes.text: If you believe we can do it, we can do it. Give yourselves the chance to be heroes.
Love always wins.
The pass is what unites the group.
Never giving up is something that when you are in United’s academy, they give it to you from then.
It really was tough but all worth it.
